meta.name: El Rey Rebel
meta.description:
From filmmaker Robert Rodriguez, El Rey Rebel sets your rebellious spirit on fire. Unleash your inner rebel with raw action, fearless fun and pure mayhem. We live for Kung Fu classics, grindhouse, gritty crime and all the adrenaline fuel you can handle.

Shows: From Dusk Till Dawn, Empire State, The Foreigner, Primal, Rebel Without a Crew
Available on: Pluto TV, The Roku Channel, Plex
